# Discodermolide

**Molecular formula:** C₃₃H₅₅NO₈

CC[C@H]1OC(=O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@H](OC(N)=O)[C@@H](C)[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](C)/C=C(C)/[C@@H](O)[C@H](C)/C=C\[C@@H](C)[C@@H](O)[C@H]1C

**Key structural features:**

- Multiple methyl-branched stereocenters
- Two Z/E-configured trisubstituted alkenes
- Several hydroxyl groups decorating the polyketide backbone

Discodermolide is a polyketide natural product isolated from the marine sponge *Discodermia dissoluta*, notable for its potent microtubule-stabilizing activity, similar in mechanism to paclitaxel (Taxol).
